title: Townsend Brown in the Bahamas with William Stephenson

tellings.quote: He also spent an inordinate amount of time in the Bahamas with the inspiration for James Bond and Winston Churchill super spy William Stephenson.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels, in a 2025 episode, talks about a man named Townsend Brown. Michels says Brown spent an unusual amount of time in the Bahamas with William Stephenson, a spy for Winston Churchill who inspired the character James Bond, which would tie Brown to the world of intelligence agencies.
